name: Heist Tycoon💰
desc:
👍 LIKE the game and join the group for $2,500 cash!

💸 Build your very own bank, unlock and upgrade defense units, and stop robbers from reaching the vault!

⚔️ Raid other players' banks for cash rewards!

- You make more money based on how many buttons you own.
- You also are rewarded with money for every robber you destroy at the end of each wave.
